gloss: to flow in; to pour in; to influx

definitions.gloss: to flow in; to pour in
definitions.explanation: For water, liquid, or air to physically flow into a place.

definitions.gloss: to flow in; to influx; to pour in (of people, money, information)
definitions.explanation: For people, capital, goods, or information to enter in large quantities. Common in economic and demographic contexts.

examples.english: With the spread of the internet, a large volume of information from overseas has begun flowing in.

notes:
The noun form ⟦{流入|りゅうにゅう}→流入：13326_ryuunyuu⟧ is frequently used as a modifier (e.g., ⟦{人口|じんこう}→人口：01618_jinkou⟧⟦{流入|りゅうにゅう}→流入：13326_ryuunyuu⟧ — population influx). The antonym is ⟦{流出|りゅうしゅつ}→流出：13327_ryuushutsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to flow out, to drain away).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{資金|しきん}→資金：09937_shikin⟧⟦{流入|りゅうにゅう}→流入：13326_ryuunyuu⟧: capital inflow
- ⟦{人口|じんこう}→人口：01618_jinkou⟧⟦{流入|りゅうにゅう}→流入：13326_ryuunyuu⟧: population influx
- ⟦{流入|りゅうにゅう}→流入：13326_ryuunyuu⟧⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧: volume of inflow
- ⟦{外国|がいこく}→外国：02868_gaikoku⟧⟦{資本|しほん}→資本：03197_shihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{流入|りゅうにゅう}→流入：13326_ryuunyuu⟧: inflow of foreign capital

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{流出|りゅうしゅつ}→流出：13327_ryuushutsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to flow out — the antonym, used for brain drain, capital flight, etc.
- ⟦{流|なが}れ{込|こ}む→流れ込む：05748_nagarekomu⟧: to flow into — more colloquial, used for both literal and figurative contexts
- ⟦{殺到|さっとう}→殺到：15036_sattou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to flood in — implies overwhelming volume, especially of requests or people
